text: /* @component: .custom-swiper-center-scale */ (function() { function initCenterScaleSwiper() { const container = document.querySelector('.custom-swiper-center-scale'); if (!container) return; new Swiper('.custom-swiper-center-scale', { slidesPerView: 3, centeredSlides: true, spaceBetween: 30, loop: true, speed: 600, navigation: { nextEl: '.swiper-button-center-next', prevEl: '.swiper-button-center-prev' }, pagination: { el: '.swiper-center-scale-pagination', clickable: true, bulletClass: 'custom-bullet', bulletActiveClass: 'is-active' }, breakpoints: { 320: { slidesPerView: 1.4, spaceBetween: 15 }, 640: { slidesPerView: 2.2, spaceBetween: 20 }, 1024: { slidesPerView: 3, spaceBetween: 30 } } }); } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { initCenterScaleSwiper(); } else { let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(script); } script.addEventListener('load', initCenterScaleSwiper); } })();
